name: reviewable-artifacts-mcp

tools.name: get_connection_state
tools.description: Reports whether this MCP profile is connected and the next action.

tools.name: start_web_authorization
tools.description: Starts browser authorization and returns an approval URL plus a human verification code. The code is not a credential.

tools.name: check_authorization
tools.description: Exchanges an approved browser authorization and activates the granted tools.

tools.name: disconnect
tools.description: Deletes this local MCP profile's web authorization and returns to connection tools.

tools.name: list_reviews
tools.description: Lists reviews from the configured owner workspace, or only configured share URLs in share mode. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

tools.name: get_review
tools.description: Composes the session GET with the consolidations list. Returns the authorized role, decision counts, latest snapshot, and the current HTML visual-projection lifecycle with a safe reason code. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

tools.name: get_threads
tools.description: Returns review threads; accepts a disposition filter. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

disposition.description: Only return threads with this disposition.

tools.name: get_handoff
tools.description: Fetches the latest snapshot or a requested snapshot id in JSON or Markdown. The export payload is passed through byte-identical. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

snapshot_id.description: Immutable snapshot id; latest when omitted.

tools.name: get_artifact
tools.description: Returns current artifact HTML, echoes its current version id, and flags whether it differs from a requested snapshot's version_ref.id. include_targets optionally includes projection targets for anchor resolution. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

snapshot_id.description: Snapshot whose version should be compared.

expected_version_ref.description: Version ref or version id expected by the caller.

include_targets.description: Include projection targets for stable-anchor resolution.

tools.name: get_execution_package
tools.description: Fetches a self-contained approved execution package by immutable snapshot reference. Apply only the listed actions to their targets. Stop when delivery_state is stale, revoked, blocked, or ambiguous; never infer unrelated changes.

tools.name: get_review_evidence
tools.description: Fetches the immutable review-evidence sidecar with exact source, bundle, view and visual-region attachment references. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

tools.name: get_review_evidence_attachment
tools.description: Fetches one immutable evidence attachment by the id returned from get_review_evidence. Binary bytes are returned as an MCP embedded resource, never injected into text. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

tools.name: create_review
tools.description: Creates a private HTML review in the configured owner workspace and returns an owner-only review URL. It never creates or returns a reviewer share link. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

file_name.description: Optional source filename for the artifact.

idempotency_key.description: Stable 8-200 character key; reuse it only when retrying the same artifact.

tools.name: list_preparations
tools.description: Lists durable HTML/ZIP preparation jobs visible to this connection. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

tools.name: get_preparation
tools.description: Returns one preparation job, its diagnostics, generation, source and resulting review id. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

preparation.description: Preparation job id returned by prepare_review.

tools.name: prepare_review
tools.description: Uploads an explicit local HTML or ZIP path into a durable private preparation job. The server never interprets this path. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

file_path.description: Explicit path on the MCP client's machine to an HTML or ZIP file.

file_name.description: Optional safe .html, .htm or .zip source filename; defaults to the local basename.

idempotency_key.description: Stable 8-200 character key; reuse only for the same file.

tools.name: retry_preparation
tools.description: Retries a terminal preparation and optionally selects one HTML entry from a ZIP. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

preparation.description: Preparation job id returned by prepare_review.

tools.name: supply_preparation_resources
tools.description: Uploads explicit local resource files and retries a preparation without overwriting original package files. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

preparation.description: Preparation job id returned by prepare_review.

file_path.description: Explicit local file path on the MCP client's machine.

path.description: Virtual package path referenced by the HTML.

resource_url.description: Original exact HTTPS URL when supplying an external resource.

tools.name: cancel_preparation
tools.description: Cancels queued or running preparation work while retaining its accepted source for recovery. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

preparation.description: Preparation job id returned by prepare_review.

tools.name: open_exploration
tools.description: Opens a short-lived isolated interaction session for the configured review and returns its first exact viewport frame. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

tools.name: send_exploration_input
tools.description: Sends one event bound to the exact displayed frame and returns the next exact frame. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

input.description: One pointer, key, scroll, resize, or close event from the closed interaction vocabulary.

tools.name: get_exploration
tools.description: Returns the current frame of an existing isolated exploration session. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

tools.name: freeze_exploration
tools.description: Persists the exact displayed frame as an immutable review view and returns the identical PNG. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

tools.name: list_review_views
tools.description: Lists immutable frozen views for the configured review without starting a runtime session. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

tools.name: get_review_view
tools.description: Returns one immutable frozen view and its exact PNG without starting a runtime session. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

tools.name: close_exploration
tools.description: Closes the isolated exploration session and releases its runtime capacity. Handoffs are immutable and additive-only within agent-context/v1; execution packages carry approved work out and regeneration results carry proposed artifacts back. feedback_type and severity are reserved/non-normative, so consumers must not branch on them.

tools.name: submit_regeneration
tools.description: Submits one immutable proposed HTML version against the exact execution package named in the result. The server derives agent identity from the grant. Every execution-package action ref must appear exactly once; non-addressed outcomes require a note.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this exact result; reuse the identical key when retrying after an uncertain response.

instructions: Reviewable is not connected. Use start_web_authorization to open browser approval; never paste credentials into chat. The review tools are listed and return a not-connected error until authorization succeeds.
